status_effects.explanation: The narrator's absorbed, admiring contemplation of her photographed features locally elevates her as an object of fascination and esteem.
Saint-Loup's choice to exclude his officer comrades in favor of exclusive time with the narrator positions the narrator as singled-out, valued company.

appraisal_events.evidence: cette photographie c'était comme une rencontre de plus ajoutée à celles que j'avais déjà faites de Mme de Guermantes... et leur contemplation... m'était une voluptueuse découverte, une faveur
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator lingers rapturously over Saint-Loup's photograph of Mme de Guermantes, treating the contemplation of her features as a prized, almost illicit privilege distinct from Robert's own gain.

appraisal_events.evidence: même pour moi, ils me gâteraient ces instants si précieux que j'ai tant désirés
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup declines to bring in his fellow officers, explaining that he values his private time with the narrator too much to spoil it, singling the narrator out as preferred, exclusive company.
